title: Spin-resolved double-trace thermal coefficients in holography
summary: It was previously shown that the stress-tensor sector of the OPE, together with the KMS condition, fixes holographic thermal two-point functions at vanishing spatial separation. We extend this construction to nonzero spatial separation, where the KMS condition leaves a residual ambiguity that depends only on the spatial separation. We show that this ambiguity is fixed by the zero-frequency bulk wave equation, which can be solved analytically in terms of Heun functions.
